"In a research station deep inside the so called "Flesh Cave", a lovely young woman conducted her experiments. As usual, the company was conducting its own experiment onto her. While she studied the intense pheromones exuded from the fleshy organisms that lived in the Flesh Cave, she found herself more and more aroused. As she looked upon the phallic creatures, her ovaries ached with alien desires... Soon enough, her sultry moans attracted the attention of an infected scientist; he promptly sought her out and the two engaged in the final phase of the experiment: conception!"
